decks.notes: The main idea of this Gruul Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. By utilizing cards like Monstrous Rage, Burst Lightning, and Reckless Rage, you can efficiently clear your opponent's board while building up your own with creatures like Soul-Scar Mage, Emberheart Challenger, and Manifold Mouse. This deck focuses on dealing damage quickly and efficiently to maintain board control and pressure your opponent into making unfavorable trades. With a mix of burn spells and aggressive creatures, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This Orzhov Aggro deck focuses on graveyard synergy and tribal synergy, utilizing creatures like Champion of the Perished and Wayward Servant to quickly build a board presence and drain the opponent's life total. The deck includes disruptive spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board and protect its threats. The inclusion of cards like Cryptbreaker and Relentless Dead allow for card advantage and recursion, keeping the pressure on the opponent. With a mix of aggressive creatures and removal spells, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and close out games quickly.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal spells, card draw, and disruption using cards like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Narset, Parter of Veils. It aims to establish a strong board presence with a focus on Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion, allowing for additional value through flickering permanents. The deck also utilizes a variety of lands to ensure consistent mana production and provides multiple win conditions through creatures like Overlord of the Floodpits and The Meathook Massacre.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly take down opponents in a one vs one format. The key strategy is to apply pressure early with efficient creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Mutavault, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with discard spells like Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with threats from the opponent. Additionally, cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Fear of Missing Out provide additional reach and card advantage to help secure victories.

The deck focuses on utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to sacrifice lower-cost creatures and search for higher-cost ones, creating a powerful board presence. It also includes a Companion, Yorion, to provide additional value and flexibility in gameplay. The deck includes a variety of lands for mana fixing and powerful threats such as Archon of Emeria, Atraxa, Grand Unifier, and Linvala, the Preserver. Overall, the key strategy is to control the board, generate value through sacrificing creatures, and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and enchantments.

This deck focuses on utilizing Gyruda, Doom of Depths' ability to potentially cheat out powerful creatures from the deck, while also using Spinewoods Armadillo and Quintorius Kand to generate tokens for additional value. The combo aspect of the deck is further enhanced by cards like Spark Double and Release to the Wind, allowing for flexibility and unexpected plays. Leyline Binding and Greater Tanuki provide disruption and control elements, ensuring the deck can protect its key pieces while setting up explosive combos for a strong finish.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disrupting the opponent's strategy through a combination of efficient creatures, removal spells, and hand disruption. The key strategy revolves around quickly pressuring the opponent with creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Blade of the Oni while using cards like Fatal Push, Thoughtseize, and Duress to control the game and protect your own threats. Additionally, the deck leverages powerful late-game plays with cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to ensure victory even in longer games.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by using counterspells, board wipes, and card draw to outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of the companion card, Yorion, Sky Nomad, allows for additional card advantage and flexibility in the long game. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a strong board presence with powerful threats like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and The Wandering Emperor. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells.

This Selesnya Aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with efficient creatures and disruption spells. By utilizing cards like Archon of Emeria and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, it aims to slow down the opponent's game plan while quickly building a board presence with creatures like Aven Interrupter and Skyclave Apparition. Collected Company provides additional creature advantage, while cards like Voice of Resurgence and Knight of Autumn offer flexibility and disruption. The deck aims to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy to secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on using Enigmatic Incarnation to sacrifice lower-cost creatures in order to tutor for powerful higher-cost creatures. The key strategy is to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Vanishing Verse while setting up your enchantment to constantly generate value. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a powerful companion that can flicker your creatures for additional value. The deck includes a variety of triome lands and powerful creatures like Zur, Eternal Schemer and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to dominate the battlefield and outvalue your opponent.

This deck focuses on using control elements to manipulate the game and disrupt the opponent's strategies. It includes a companion card, Yorion, Sky Nomad, and utilizes cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, Narset, Parter of Veils, and Omen of the Sea to control the battlefield. The deck also includes cards that generate card advantage, such as Grim Bauble and Stormchaser's Talent, as well as powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The mana base is designed to support the control strategy, with a mix of dual lands and utility lands.

The primary focus of this deck is to maintain control over the game by utilizing a combination of disruption, card advantage, and removal spells. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's game plan while building its own resources and eventually overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a companion to provide additional value and flexibility in longer games. The deck is designed to outlast aggressive strategies and grind out victories through careful decision-making and resource management.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to quickly deploy threats like Soul-Scar Mage, Heartfire Hero, and Emberheart Challenger to pressure the opponent while using spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage to clear the opponent's blockers. The deck also includes mana acceleration with cards like Copperline Gorge and Questing Druid to quickly ramp into powerful threats. The combination of efficient creatures and burn spells makes this deck a fast and formidable force in Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on quickly pressuring the opponent with a mix of disruptive spells and evasive creatures. The key strategy is to maintain control of the battlefield while aggressively attacking the opponent's life total. By combining powerful removal spells with efficient creatures such as Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Mockingbird, the deck aims to apply consistent pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also benefits from a strong mana base with a mix of dual lands to ensure a smooth curve and consistent access to all colors of mana.

This deck focuses on using artifacts as a way to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. By utilizing cards like Ensoul Artifact and Shrapnel Blast, players can turn their artifacts into powerful threats while also having access to additional removal spells like Burst Lightning and Torch the Tower to deal with opposing creatures. The inclusion of cards like Smuggler's Copter and Spyglass Siren helps to further enhance the deck's aggressive strategy, allowing it to quickly close out games against the opponent.

The deck revolves around quickly casting spells to trigger the Arclight Phoenix's ability to return from the graveyard, putting pressure on the opponent with fast, aggressive plays. The deck includes card draw and selection spells to maintain a consistent flow of spells to trigger the Phoenixes, while also including some disruptive elements like counterspells and removal to control the game. The inclusion of large delve spells like Treasure Cruise and Temporal Trespass synergizes well with the strategy, allowing for explosive turns and potential for massive swings in momentum.
